entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I have the right account, could I get your name and order number?
The name is Sam Jones, and the order was VF-881-92B.
Thank you, Sam. I see the order here, delivered 28 days ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault. The heart rate monitor is wildly inaccurate. Honestly, the thing is a piece of garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear that it's not performing as expected. That sounds frustrating. I'd be happy to walk you through a couple of quick troubleshooting steps. Sometimes a sensor recalibration can resolve that immediately.
No, I'm not interested in that. I don't have time to be tech support for your product. I just want money for my refund.
I understand you'd prefer a straightforward return. Let me just pull up our current policy to check the eligibility on your order. Please hold for one moment.
Thanks for your patience, Sam. Okay, I've just reviewed our policy, and it states that all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery.
Since you're at day 28, you're well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and start that return for you right now.
Oh. That's it? I was prepared to negotiate. So you're just approving the refund?

That's correct. No negotiation necessary. The policy is 10 days, so you're all set. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on file. Once we receive the band at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Wow, okay. That was much easier than I expected. Thank you, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
